{
  "product_name": "CloudSoft Comfort Diapers",
  "headline": "Where Comfort Meets Dryness: The Diaper Babies Actually Love",
  "subheadline": "Engineered for ultra-softness and all-day leak protection, so your little one stays happy, dry, and free to explore.",
  "body_copy": "Say goodbye to fussiness from uncomfortable diapers. CloudSoft Comfort Diapers feature a cloud-like inner liner made from plant-based fibers that feel gentle against delicate skin, paired with our breakthrough DryLock™ core that pulls moisture away fast. The flexible, 360° stretch waistband moves with your baby — no sagging, no gaps, just pure comfort from first crawl to bedtime snuggles. Trusted by parents and designed with pediatric input, because every baby deserves to feel as good as they look.",
  "key_features": [
    "Ultra-soft, plant-based inner liner for sensitive skin",
    "DryLock™ core technology for 12-hour leak protection",
    "Breathable outer cover to prevent overheating",
    "360° stretch waistband for a secure, move-with-you fit",
    "Wetness indicator that changes color when it's time for a change",
    "Hypoallergenic, fragrance-free, and chlorine-free"
  ],
  "call_to_action": "Give your baby the comfort they deserve — try CloudSoft Comfort Diapers today!",
  "target_audience": "New parents and caregivers seeking premium comfort and reliability for infants 0-24 months"
}
